name: lib_simpleGraph_sum_degree_sq_le_of_cliqueFree_three
statement: (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.CliqueFree 3) : ∑ v, G.degree v ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card V * G.edgeFinset.card
closed: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (h : G.CliqueFree 3), ∑ v, G.degree v ^ 2 ≤ Fintype.card V * G.edgeFinset.card
informal: In a triangle-free graph the sum of squared degrees is at most n * e (n vertices, e edges), since deg u + deg v ≤ n for every edge uv; the key step of Mantel's theorem. Promoted from Mathlib2.bld2_mantel_equality_regular_aux1 (also proved inline in bld_mantel_triangle_free).
